question: How should one remember the mantra when facing all kinds of difficulties?
premises: The practice involves remembering the mantra.
The remembrance must be constant and unwearied.
inference: In all difficulties one should always remember the mantra unweariedly.
uncertainties: The repetition of atandritaḥ may be emphatic or due to textual transmission.
plain_english: Whoever, in all difficulties, always remembers the mantra unwearied, unwearied...
